name: Storage Drives
author: Charles Gameti
description: Every drive in the Omarchy bar: USB sticks, SD cards, phones, internal disks and cloud drives. Mount, inspect, format, repair NTFS, sync Google Drive, Mega, OneDrive and Dropbox, and eject safely, with a bar icon that pulses red and shows which drive is being written and how fast.

barWidget.description: View all drives and storage on the machine, monitor stats, format, auto-repair NTFS, and safely eject removable media.

schema.label: Auto-mount drives on connect
schema.description: Automatically mount removable volumes and recover dirty NTFS partitions when plugged in.

schema.label: Empty drive trash on eject
schema.description: Automatically purge deleted files inside .Trash on the drive before unmounting.

schema.label: Show All Machine Drives (including OS & Swap)
schema.description: Display internal NVMe/SSD, swap, and root filesystems alongside removable media.

schema.label: Notify on connect and remove
schema.description: Announce drives as they are plugged in, and warn when one is unplugged while still mounted.

schema.label: Unmount drives before sleep
schema.description: Unmount every removable volume when the machine suspends, so a drive unplugged while it sleeps is not left half-written.

schema.label: Text beside the icon
schema.description: Show free space, the drive's name, or how many are attached. Vertical bars stay icon-only.

schema.label: Always show the icon
schema.description: Keep the icon in the bar even when no removable drive is attached.

schema.label: Open after mounting
schema.description: Open the file manager once a volume finishes mounting.

schema.label: File manager command
schema.description: Command used to open a mount point. Leave empty to use xdg-open.

schema.label: Free-space refresh (seconds)
schema.description: How often free space is re-read while the panel is open. Drives are detected instantly through udev either way.

schema.label: Nearly full at (%)
schema.description: A volume's usage bar and free-space line turn the urgent colour at this fill level.

schema.label: Warn when a drive's health gets worse
schema.description: Health is read in the background when drives change and every six hours, and a drive reporting itself failing is announced at once.

schema.label: Warn when a drive is nearly full
schema.description: Notify once when any mounted volume, the system drive included, crosses the nearly-full level.

schema.label: Thumb drive size limit (GB)
schema.description: USB disks this size or smaller get the thumb-drive icon unless the model name says otherwise. Bigger ones show as external drives.
